speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing chronic diarrhea and lower abdominal discomfort; to begin my evaluation, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and have you noticed any blood in your stool or unintended weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. The patient notes the bowel movements are urgent, occasionally accompanied by mucus discharge, and often followed by a feeling of incomplete evacuation. She went camping several months ago and recalls another member of the camping party falling ill recently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Crohn's Disease)

While your camping story suggests a foodborne illness, your specific symptoms of urgency, mucus, and a feeling of incomplete evacuation strongly point toward an inflammatory condition like IBD or Ulcerative Colitis. Have you noticed any blood in your stool, and do you have a family history of these conditions?
